notes.title: 『Holiday Update』Ver1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44678111/53ecd86e367c26ed57bc2f3578a02a2debe1b86e.jpg[/img]
[b]Thank you to everyone who has played and featured our game in videos since its release! As 2023 draws to a close and the cold season sets in, we'd like to share the details of our latest update with everyone.[/b]

[h3]◆ Addition of Accessories[/h3]
[b]・Santa Claus hat
・Kagami mochi
・Edo-style spinning top[/b]

[b]◆ Addition of a New Stage[/b]

[h3]These new accessories will be distributed directly after the game update. Let's spin some macho spinners over the New Year![/h3]

notes.title: Game Update Ver1.0.2
notes.content:
[h3]◆ Bug Fixes [/h3]
[b]・ Fixed the issue of progression failure and infinite loading during Ranked Matches.
・ Fixed the issue of progression failure during rematches. [/b]

[h3]◆ Specification Improvements [/h3]
[b]・ Changes to the "Rematch" specification: In Ranked Matches, a rematch will now occur only when both player select "Rematch." [/b]

[h3]◆ Specification Changes [/h3]
[b]・ At the start of matchmaking, the "Cancel" button cannot be pressed for 5 seconds.
・ Upon successful matchmaking, the "Cancel" button cannot be pressed.
※ Changes were made to the specifications because canceling during matchmaking was causing bugs. [/b]

notes.title: Game Update Ver1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Thank you so much to everyone who played on the first day! We truly appreciate it. We've worked on fixing various bugs and issues encountered during gameplay, such as infinite loading. Here are the details of the update patch: [/b]

[h3]◆ Bug Fixes [/h3]
[b]・ Single Player: Fixed the issue of NPCs floating in mid-air.
・ Multiplayer: Resolved the bug where points didn't update when initiating a rematch in ranked matches.[/b]

[h3]◆ Improvements in Ranked Matchmaking [/h3]
[b]・ Addressed the issue causing infinite loading during matchmaking. [/b]
※ We've fixed the problem occurring when the same host was matched with multiple players, and now, players unable to match successfully will automatically become hosts.

[b]・ Issue of infinite loading on the VS screen [/b]
We are currently investigating the above issue. Your understanding is appreciated. If you encounter infinite loading, we apologize, but please restart the game once.

[h3]◆ UI Enhancements [/h3]
[b]・ Updated buttons in multiplayer mode. [/b]
[b]・ Adjusted the size of numbers in the ranked match results screen. [/b]
[b]・ You can now create a private free match room.[/b]
